title: Austin's Modern Moves: Taxis, Bridges, Gas Stations
summary:
*   Adjusted routes and license fees for jitney (early taxi) car operators, including refunds due to changes in city ordinances.
*   Awarded a contract for the construction of a new concrete bridge over Waller Creek and accepted the completion of paving on West 9th Street.
*   Authorized a significant $1.17 million bond trip to New York City for city officials to manage refunding bonds.
*   Approved a permit for a gasoline tank and pump installation under a downtown sidewalk, specifying detailed conditions for its operation.

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution: Whereas, a license to operate
a Jitney has heretofore been issued by the City Tax Assessor & Collector,under authority
of the City Council,which license is numbered 6 upon the Books of said City Tax Assessor &
Collector,and the fee of fifty dollars at said time required under the ordinances of the
City of Austin was paid be said W B Calloway for such license; and Whereas, the ordinance
regulating jitneys was thereafter amended fixing the license fee at $ 25.00 in lieu of $
50.00,theretofore required ,and in certain other particulars which made it necessary that
said W B Calloway have a new license for said purpose; and Whereas, the City Council has
heretofore refunded to said W B Calloway $ 25.00, on said $ 50.00 heretofore paid by him
to said City Tax Assessor & Coll -ector,and there is now in the City Treasury the sum of $
25.00, to the credit of the said W B Calloway,which, at his request,should be applied to
the payment for a new license required under said amended ordinance; Now, therefore, Be it
resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That the license numbers 6 on the
books of the City Tax Assessor & Collector to operate a jitney heretofore issued to W B
Calloway,be and the same is hereby cancelled and revoked ,and the City Tax Assessor &
Collector is hereby instructed to mark same as revoked upon his books ,and said W B
Calloway having been granted a permit to operate a jitney on May 8,1916, and in
consideration of the premises ,said City Tax Assessor & Collector is hereby authorized and
instructed to issue a new license to said W B Calloway based upon said application,without
any money being paid to the Collector.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Barthelemew, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Anthony 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

.Councilman Powell offered the following resolution: Whereas, in construction of a brick

having obtained permission so to do from the City Council ; Now therefore be it resolved

Hillyer to construct a catch basin outside of and adjacent to the alley, same to be
constructed according to, and in strict compliance with, the ordinance governing such
appliances and under the supervision of the City Engineer of the City of Austin, Texas .

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin,Texas: That a permit is hereby granted to Miles P and
Wallace R Miller to install and maintain a five barrel gasoline tank made of twelve guage
iron rivited ,dimension26"by 5'to be approved by the Supt of Police and Public
Safety,under the sidewalk on east 7th street in front of numbers 112 to 118 in the City of
Austin, Texas .

Resolved further:
That in conn ction with this gasoline tank hereby authorized to be installed,the said
Miles P and Wallace R Miller are likewise authorized to install and maintain a gasoline
pump to be located at the curb line in front of numbers 112 to 118 East 7th.street at a
position to be designated by the Supt of Streets and Public Improvements;said gasoline
pump to be of the most modern and approved construction and design and subject to the
approval of the Supt of Police and Public Safety.g Resolved further: That the hose trough
which air , Gasoline,or any other oil or volitile substance is conveyed ,by pumping or
otherwise ,from the store house at 112 to 118 East 7th streeter from the tank authorized
to be placed in front of the same must be kept ,when not in actual use ,neatly coiled,and
stored in a receptacle provided for such hose in the pump as authorized to be installed or
suspended from a suitable bracket attached to the pump. Resolved further: That the work
under this resolution authorized to be installed and maintained must be installed and
maintained ,where not otherwise assigned ,under the immediate supervision of the City
Engineer of Austin, Texas, who is hereby authorized to prescribe necessary specifications
for the work herein authorized to be done.
Resolved further and finally:
That this permit is granted only for the installation of a gasoline tank and pump and does
not include the installation or construction of a storage box for hose underneath the
sidewalk ,and that this permit is granted and must be accepted as revocable at any time in
the pleasure of the City Council.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Barthelemew, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Anthony 1
The Council then adjourned.
